content:
The Wanted Man is a newly announced Apple TV+ drama starring Hugh Laurie, who plays a jailed crime boss preparing to escape from prison. Here are the details.

The Wanted Man is an upcoming crime drama on Apple TV+.

Crime thrillers have always been one of Apple TV+'s most popular genres, and the streaming service has just unveiled its latest offering.

The Wanted Man will premiere its first two episodes on Wednesday, January 6, with new episodes releasing weekly until the finale on February 17.

Hugh Laurie stars as a crime boss betrayed by someone inside his own organisation, who is sentenced to prison and plans an escape. The cast also includes Thandiwe Newton, Fionn Whitehead, Gina McKee, Hazel Doupe, Elliott Heffernan, and Stephen Dillane.

The Wanted Man is created by George Kay, who also created the Idris Elba-starring series Hijack.

If you're looking for more crime dramas, Last Seen and a new season of Slow Horses are currently streaming, with Nocturne starring Liev Schreiber joining next month.

Are you interested in watching The Wanted Man? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below.

Apple TV+ costs $14.99 per month, and you can also get a discount through the Apple One bundle.
